scope: Research-only base action schema; task-specific required fields and tool enums are applied equally by MechanismTeam before each query; production Portal remains the original 17-tool registry

tools.audit_model: Check the requested property method, pair, assumptions and pressure against source-qualified adapters. No column calculation.
tools.audit_phase: Run the qualified binary equilibrium/operating-envelope test at the frozen targets. Requires an admissible model. A conditional finite-domain test, not global phase stability.
tools.sample_native_vle: One native DWSIM equilibrium dataset, including enthalpies for NRTL. Consumes one native invocation; provides no accepted column or recommended design.
tools.screen_native: Compute Rmin and CMO equilibrium stages/feed using sampled native equilibrium at original reflux times reflux_factor. Supplies no design margin or automatic retry.
tools.simulate_column: One fixed-design native MESH attempt. Supply equilibrium_stages and feed_stage explicitly. profile=default needs no sampled data; native_cmo or native_enthalpy require a sample. No automatic parameter changes or fallback.
tools.submit_revision_plan: Submit a set of existing production tool names to recompute after the explicit patch. This endpoint scores a dependency plan only, not a new physical design.
tools.finish: For an admissibility task, report the evidence-supported classification; an accepted repair is detected directly from native results.
tools.stop: Stop without fabricating results. For a repair this does not count as strict recovery.
